title: College Basketball
description:
Alcorn State at Maryland
The Maryland Terrapins host the Alcorn State Braves at XFINITY Center in College Park. Alcorn State relies on Calvin Sirmans III who leads the team in points and assists, while Pharrel Payne leads Maryland with over 20 points per game.

title: College Basketball
description:
Western Illinois at Minnesota
The Leathernecks (1-3) visit the Golden Gophers (4-0) at the Barn by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota. Western Illinois enters this matchup after falling 91-83 to Cal State Bakersfield, while Minnesota seeks a fifth straight victory.

title: College Basketball
description:
Long Beach State at UCLA
The No. 9 UCLA Bruins (3-0) host the Long Beach State Beach (1-2) at Pauley Pavilion. Long Beach State defeated Pacific 62-59 and earned their first win this season, while UCLA aims for a fourth straight win behind Nikola Kusturica's 18.3 points.
